concerns.text: SC-003 requires measuring the reliability‑diagram slope deviation (≤ 0.05) and reporting it, but no task computes or validates this slope; T007 only creates a diagram image.

SC-004 mandates a PIT‑KS test with a p‑value > 0.05 for recalibrated methods, yet the task list only mentions generating a PIT histogram (results/pit_histogram_raw.png) and provides no test or logging of the KS statistic.

FR‑004 (and the plan) state that bins with < 200 samples must be *pooled* with adjacent bins or *fallback* to raw forecasts. T010 only logs and skips fitting for those bins, violating the specified handling and weakening the isotonic regression requirement.

SC‑006 expects the physics‑informed prior to demonstrably achieve a lower Brier score than the flat prior, but T017 merely logs prior‑sensitivity runs without any verification or assertion of the required improvement.

FR‑008 requires explicit enforcement and monitoring of total pipeline runtime (≤ 6 h), isotonic step (≤ 30 min) and Bayesian step (≤ 60 min). No task measures, records, or aborts on exceeding these limits, so the constraint is absent.

SC‑009 demands verification that the validation split prevents data leakage (no test observation precedes any training observation). The isotonic trainer description does not include any check or assertion of this property.
